name: Costa Mesa
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Costa Mesa, CA 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Costa Mesa, California for 2026: Santa's Express Train at South Coast Plaza, Winter Fest OC, Snoopy House and two Nutcrackers.
lede: Costa Mesa pairs big-venue holiday traditions, from Santa's Express Train at South Coast Plaza to two Nutcrackers at Segerstrom Center, with a Snoopy House light display on the City Hall lawn.
celebrates: Costa Mesa's Christmas season runs on a few big venues. South Coast Plaza turns its carousel horses into Santa's reindeer, runs Santa's Express Train for $2 a ride and opens Santa's Village in Carousel Court. The OC Fair & Event Center fills Lot A with Winter Fest OC, with ice tubing, skating, snow play and carnival rides. Segerstrom Center for the Arts stages Pacific Symphony's Nutcracker for Kids and American Ballet Theatre's The Nutcracker, while South Coast Repertory presents A Christmas Carol. The City of Costa Mesa adds Snoopy House, a Peanuts light display at City Hall, for one week in December.
lastyear: In 2025, South Coast Repertory's A Christmas Carol began on November 29, according to the theater's 2025 page. South Coast Plaza's 2025 press release, dated November 26, 2025, listed Santa's Village at Carousel Court and the Reindeer Carousel among 12 holiday experiences. For 2026 the mall's Santa's Express Train runs from November 20 through January 1, and SCR opens on November 28, so the season starts a little earlier than last year.
facts: Segerstrom Center for the Arts says American Ballet Theatre's The Nutcracker is in its 11th season there in 2026, with a cast of over 100 performers. South Coast Repertory says its A Christmas Carol is in its 46th year in 2026. South Coast Plaza says its Reindeer Carousel and Santa's Express Train are available exclusively at the mall.
trains: Costa Mesa's own train is Santa's Express Train at South Coast Plaza, a $2 ride in the Crate & Barrel Wing, running from November 20 through January 1, according to the mall. Nearby, the Irvine Park Railroad in Orange runs Christmas trains and Santa's Village, according to its own site. The free Fullerton Train Museum, with seven vintage railcars and a Metrolink locomotive, opens on the first and third Saturdays of each month, according to our museum page. Disneyland's trains are covered in our Anaheim guide.

faq: Is there a train ride in Costa Mesa at Christmas?
Yes. Santa's Express Train at South Coast Plaza runs November 20 to January 1, 2026-27 for $2 a ride, with a limit of 42 inches tall and 70 pounds.
Where can kids see Santa in Costa Mesa?
South Coast Plaza has Santa's Village in Carousel Court beginning November 21. The City of Costa Mesa's Snoopy House week, December 11 to 18, also lists photos with Santa.
What Nutcracker shows are in Costa Mesa?
Pacific Symphony's The Nutcracker for Kids on December 5 and American Ballet Theatre's The Nutcracker from December 10 to 24, both at Segerstrom Center for the Arts.
Is there a free Christmas event in Costa Mesa?
The Donald Dungan Library's Winter Animal Crafts on December 23 is free. The Snoopy House page does not print a price.
Is A Christmas Carol at South Coast Repertory good for young kids?
SCR advises ages 6 and up and does not admit children under 6.

We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
